note: Razorpay settlement recon import. recon_page_size: rows per GET /v1/settlements/recon/combined page; 100 matches Razorpay's own MCP tool, and the API accepts up to 1000. csv_header_aliases: map a CSV export's column headers to the API field names, case-insensitively, e.g. {"Settlement UTR": "settlement_utr", "Entity ID": "entity_id"}. Amounts must still be integer paise.
